description: If each saturation step adds a missing resolvent and all initial atoms lie in a finite set \(S\), the number of steps is at most the number of clauses formed from the two literals on each atom of \(S\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Resolution.saturation_bound.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α] (S : Finset α)
  (states : ℕ → Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Resolution.ClauseSet α) (k : ℕ)
  (h0 : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Resolution.Supported S (states 0))
  (hs : ∀ i < k, Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Resolution.Step (states i) (states (i + 1))) :
  k ≤ (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Resolution.availableClauses S).card
